Name: HDR & Upscale Manager
ShortDescription: Per-game HDR and upscaler (FSR/OptiScaler) setup for Playnite.
Description: Configure ReShade, RenoDX/Luma HDR mods, DXVK, and OptiScaler (FSR/XeSS) per game from inside Playnite. AMD-focused today, with NVIDIA support planned. Inspired by and kept in sync with RankFTW/RHI.
Author: matheusfaustino
